recipes.title: Pikelets (Mini Pancakes)
recipes.description: Small, thick New Zealand and Australian griddle pancakes, raised with yeast and served warm.

steps.instructionText: Sift the bread flour and plain flour into a large bowl, adding 1/2 tsp of the bicarbonate of soda and the salt.
Crumble the fresh yeast into a small bowl and slowly stir in the lukewarm water until you have a brown paste.
Pour the yeast mixture into the flour and mix to a very thick batter, with a wooden spoon or your hands.
Cover the bowl with a warm, damp cloth and leave in a warm place for 2 hours, until frothy.
Dissolve the rest of the bicarbonate of soda in the lukewarm milk and slowly stir it into the batter.
Heat a lightly greased frying pan until very hot. Drop in spoonfuls of batter and cook for 2 minutes on each side, turning when the bubbles dry out.

recipes.title: Pufftaloons
recipes.description: Australian fried scone dough, puffed up in hot oil and eaten warm with jam or golden syrup.

ingredients.name: jam or golden syrup, to serve

steps.instructionText: Mix the plain flour and baking powder in a bowl.
Rub in the butter with your fingertips.
Add enough milk to make a soft dough.
Heat the oil for deep frying until hot.
Deep fry spoonfuls of the dough until puffed and golden, then drain.
Serve hot with jam or golden syrup.

recipes.title: Rissoles
recipes.description: Australian beef mince patties, coated in flour and fried or baked until crisp outside, like thick burgers.

steps.instructionText: Put the minced beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, mixed dried herbs, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Mix thoroughly with your hands until fully combined.
Take a handful of the mixture and shape it into a very thick burger patty.
Roll each patty in plain flour.
Cook in the oven, under a grill or in a frying pan over medium heat until cooked through and crunchy on the outside.
Serve with vegetables, chips or salad, or in bread as a rissole burger.

recipes.title: Rocky Road
recipes.description: No-bake Australian chocolate squares full of marshmallows and walnuts, set in the fridge.

steps.instructionText: Butter a 20 cm square pan and set it aside.
Put the chocolate chips, milk and butter in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat.
Stir constantly until the chocolate has melted and the milk and butter are mixed in.
Stir in the mini marshmallows, walnuts and vanilla extract.
Spread the mixture into the prepared pan.
Refrigerate until firm, about 2 hours, then cut into small squares.

recipes.title: Lolly Cake
recipes.description: New Zealand no-bake log of crushed malt biscuits, condensed milk and chewy sweets, rolled in coconut.

steps.instructionText: Crush the malt biscuits. Leave some pieces partly crushed for a better texture.
Mix in the cinnamon.
Warm the butter and condensed milk in the microwave for 30 seconds, until the butter is very soft.
Halve the fruit puffs if you like, or leave them whole.
Mix the fruit puffs into the crushed biscuits, then add the butter and condensed milk and mix well.
Roll the mixture into a log, or into small balls.
Roll the log or balls in shredded coconut until completely covered.
Place on a tray, cover with plastic wrap and chill for several hours until hard.
Cut the cake while still cold.

recipes.title: Pie Floater
recipes.description: South Australian street-food classic: a hot meat pie served upside down in a bowl of pea soup.

steps.instructionText: Heat the meat pie in an oven so the pastry stays crisp. A microwave does not work as well.
Heat the pea soup separately in a pan.
Place the pie upside down in a bowl and pour the pea soup around it until the bowl is full.

recipes.title: Sticky Date Pudding
recipes.description: Moist, dark Australian date cake, soaked with hot brown sugar sauce and served with cream.

ingredients.name: bicarbonate of soda, for the dates
bicarbonate of soda, for the flour

steps.instructionText: Make the sauce: stir the brown sugar and water in the top of a double boiler over simmering water until the sugar dissolves. Take off the heat and let it cool.
Chop the dates roughly and put them in a saucepan with 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda and just enough water to cover.
Bring to the boil and simmer for 1 minute. When it froths up to the top of the pan, take it off the heat and let it cool.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F). Line a large cake tin with parchment paper and grease it well.
Sift the plain flour, 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda, salt and mixed spice together twice.
Beat the eggs lightly, add the castor sugar and whip until very light and fluffy, as for a sponge.
Fold in the vegetable oil and vanilla essence, without over-mixing, so you keep the air.
Fold in the sifted flour mixture, then the cooled date mixture.
Pour into the tin and bake for 80-90 minutes, until a skewer comes out dry. Leave the pudding in the tin.
Prick the hot pudding all over with a skewer and pour about 1 cup of the sauce over it so it soaks in.
Slice and serve at once with cream or ice cream.

recipes.title: Carpetbag Steak
recipes.description: Thick steak with a pocket stuffed with oysters, then grilled; an Australian classic from around 1950.

steps.instructionText: Cut a pocket about 6 cm long and about as deep into the edge of the thick steak.
Season the inside of the pocket with a little salt, black pepper, cayenne pepper, lemon juice and olive oil, if you like.
Dip the oysters in Worcestershire sauce, then push them into the pocket.
Close the pocket with a moistened skewer.
Barbecue, grill or broil the steak until done as you like it, or cook it over moderate heat in a heavy frying pan.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Sandwich
recipes.description: Crisp fried chicken breast tossed in hot sauce, in a bun with lettuce, tomato and blue cheese dressing.

ingredients.name: chicken breast, boneless and skinless, pounded flat

steps.instructionText: Heat enough oil to cover the chicken to 175 °C (350 °F) in a large frying pan or deep-fryer.
Mix the flour and salt. Dip the chicken in the milk, then the flour mixture, again in the milk, then the flour a second time.
Chill the coated chicken in the fridge for 10-15 minutes.
Deep fry the chicken in the oil until golden brown, about 10 minutes. Drain on a rack.
Toast the cut face of the bun.
Put the chicken in a bowl with a lid, add the hot sauce, close the lid and shake gently to coat.
Put the chicken on the bun and top with lettuce, tomato and red onion. Serve open-faced with blue cheese dressing on the side.

recipes.title: Corn Chowder
recipes.description: Creamy American soup of sweetcorn, potato, onion and celery, lightly flavoured with thyme.

ingredients.name: potatoes, peeled and diced in 1 cm cubes

steps.instructionText: Melt the butter in a medium saucepan. Add the onion and celery and cook until tender.
Add the potatoes, sweetcorn, salt, pepper, water, chicken bouillon cubes and thyme.
Cover and simmer for 15 minutes, until the potatoes and sweetcorn are tender.
Add the milk and light cream.
Heat through without boiling, and serve hot.

recipes.title: New England Clam Chowder
recipes.description: Thick, creamy milk-based chowder of clams, potato and onion, built on salt pork and a light roux.

steps.instructionText: Drain the clams and keep the liquid. Cut away the hard parts of the clams and keep them separate from the soft parts.
Fry the salt pork in a heavy pot until brown and crisp, then lift it out.
Fry the hard parts of the clams and the onion in the pork fat until the onion is light brown.
Stir in the flour, then slowly add the boiling water, salt, pepper and diced potato.
Cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Add the soft parts of the clams and the clam liquid.
Scald the milk. Just before serving, stir in the scalded milk and the butter, and heat through without boiling.
Serve piping hot with crackers.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Chowder
recipes.description: Creamy chowder of smoked salmon, carrots, celery, onion and mashed potato, scented with tarragon.

steps.instructionText: Heat the canola oil in a large stock pot over medium heat.
Add the carrots, onions and celery and stir until the onions turn clear.
Add the tarragon and fish stock and scrape up the bottom of the pot.
Stir in the smashed potatoes and smoked salmon. Keep stirring and bring to a simmer.
Add the milk and black pepper and heat through.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Green Bean Casserole
recipes.description: Classic American Thanksgiving side of green beans in creamy mushroom sauce, topped with crispy fried onions.

steps.instructionText: Preheat the oven to 175 °C (350 °F).
In a 3-litre casserole dish, stir together the green beans, milk, half of the French fried onions, pepper, cream of mushroom soup and soy sauce.
Bake until hot, about 25 minutes.
Sprinkle the rest of the French fried onions on top.
Bake for another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Tuna Noodle Casserole
recipes.description: Comfort-food bake of tuna, egg noodles and peas in creamy mushroom soup, with a crumb or cheese top.

ingredients.name: medium egg noodles, cooked and hot

steps.instructionText: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F).
Shred the tuna and stir it into a 3-litre casserole dish with the milk, egg noodles, peas and cream of mushroom soup.
Stir in the dried minced onion and hot sauce.
Bake until hot, about 25-30 minutes.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the melted butter and sprinkle over the casserole, or top it with the shredded cheese.
Bake for another 5 minutes.

recipes.title: Hashbrown Casserole
recipes.description: Cheesy Utah potato bake of hash browns, sour cream and cream of chicken soup under a crunchy corn flake top.

steps.instructionText: Toss the corn flakes with 1 tbsp of the melted butter and set aside.
Combine the hash browns, cheddar cheese, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, butter, green onions, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Transfer the mixture to a 28 x 33 cm baking dish.
Sprinkle the corn flake mixture on top.
Bake at 180 °C (350 °F) for 40 minutes, until bubbly and a little browned on top.

recipes.title: Breakfast Casserole
recipes.description: Layered bake of cornbread, sausage, bacon, ricotta and egg, topped with Monterey Jack and crumbs.

ingredients.name: sausage links, cooked and finely chopped

steps.instructionText: Combine the sausage and bacon in a bowl.
In another bowl, combine the ricotta, eggs, butter, salt, black pepper and cornbread.
Grease a large roasting pan. Spread just enough of the cornbread mixture to cover the bottom, then add a layer of the meat mixture. Repeat until both are used up.
Mix the Monterey Jack cheese and breadcrumbs and sprinkle evenly over the top.
Bake at 190 °C (375 °F) for 30-35 minutes, until browned and bubbly on top.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Sloppy Joes
recipes.description: Loose, saucy ground beef in a sweet-tangy ketchup and barbecue sauce, served on toasted burger buns.

steps.instructionText: Brown the ground beef, onion and bell pepper in a skillet over medium heat.
Drain off the liquid and return the mixture to the skillet.
Over medium heat, stir in the ketchup, barbecue sauce, garlic powder and chili powder.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Spoon over sliced, toasted hamburger buns.

recipes.title: Reuben Sandwich
recipes.description: Grilled rye sandwich of corned beef, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese and Russian dressing.

steps.instructionText: Mix the sauerkraut, sweet onion and parsley.
Spread the Russian dressing on both slices of rye bread.
Pile the corned beef, Swiss cheese and sauerkraut mixture on one slice, then top with the other slice.
Butter the outside of the bread.
Grill until lightly browned, about 5-10 minutes.

recipes.title: Philly Cheesesteak
recipes.description: Seared steak pieces and soft browned onion with melted cheese, piled into a hoagie roll.

steps.instructionText: Drizzle the filet mignon with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Sear in a cast-iron skillet over medium heat for 6 minutes per side.
Remove the steak and rest it for 7 minutes, then slice it into bite-size pieces and keep warm.
Toss the onion with a little olive oil and saute it in the same pan until lightly browned around the edges.
Put a big scoop of steak into each hoagie roll (cut almost through), then top with the onion and torn American cheese slices.

recipes.title: Cuban Sandwich
recipes.description: Pressed Cuban bread sandwich of ham, roast pork, salami, Swiss cheese, pickles and mustard.

steps.instructionText: Cut the Cuban bread to a size you like (about 18 cm is common), then slice it open down the middle.
Spread the mustard across the top half of the bread and lay the dill pickle slices on it.
Put the Swiss cheese on top of the pickles.
Fold each slice of boiled ham in half and place on the bottom half of the bread. Add the roast pork and salami on top.
Close the sandwich.
Press it in a sandwich grill, or a waffle iron if you do not have one, until the top is golden and crisp, about 4-6 minutes.
Remove carefully and cut diagonally from corner to corner.

recipes.title: Steak Sandwiches
recipes.description: Quick toasted loaf filled with sliced steak, pepper jack cheese and crisp bacon.

ingredients.name: French or Italian loaf, 30 cm long

steps.instructionText: Preheat the oven to 95 °C (200 °F).
Slice the tenderloin steaks thinly and split the loaf in half.
Build the sandwich with the steak, pepper jack cheese and bacon.
Toast in the oven until the cheese has melted and the bread is toasted.

recipes.title: Grilled Peanut Butter Sandwich
recipes.description: Pan-fried peanut butter sandwich with a golden, buttery crust and a melting centre; Elvis's favourite.

steps.instructionText: Spread the peanut butter between the two slices of bread.
Spread the outsides of the bread with softened or melted butter.
Cook in a non-stick skillet over medium heat, turning a few times, until the bread is golden brown and the peanut butter has melted.
Serve with plenty of milk.

recipes.title: Black Bean Chili
recipes.description: Meatless Tex-Mex chili of slow-simmered black beans, smoky chipotle, cumin and tomato, topped with sour cream.

steps.instructionText: Put the black beans in a large pot with enough water to cover by 2.5 cm and soak overnight.
Drain the beans, cover with fresh water, bring to the boil, then simmer for 2 hours.
Heat the corn oil in a very large pot over medium-high heat. Add the onion and saute until tender.
Add the garlic, chipotle and ancho chile, cumin, paprika, oregano, sea salt, cayenne pepper and wine vinegar and saute for 5-10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, tomato puree and water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the beans with their juice and simmer for 1 hour.
Serve with sour cream.

recipes.title: Green Chili Beef Stew
recipes.description: New Mexican beef stew with roasted green chiles, potato, celery and corn; good with tortillas.

ingredients.name: green New Mexican chiles, roasted and peeled

steps.instructionText: Heat the vegetable oil in a skillet. Brown the beef on all sides, then move it to a stock pot.
Add the onion to the skillet and saute until browned.
Add the garlic to the onion and cook for a couple more minutes, then move both to the stock pot.
Add the green chiles, potatoes, water, oregano, celery and canned corn to the pot.
Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 1-2 hours, until the beef is very tender.
Serve with tortillas.

recipes.title: Spanish Rice (Tex-Mex)
recipes.description: Tex-Mex rice cooked in chicken broth with chorizo, shredded meat, peppers, serrano chiles and cilantro.

steps.instructionText: Melt the butter in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the onion, bell pepper, serrano chiles, garlic, shredded meat, chorizo and rice. Cook until the chorizo and rice are golden brown.
Add the chicken broth and bay leaves. Bring to the boil and cook until the liquid has evaporated and the rice is tender.
Sprinkle with the cilantro before serving.

recipes.title: Homemade Tomato Ketchup
recipes.description: Simple ketchup of tomato paste, malt vinegar, garlic and onion powder, boiled for 15 minutes.

steps.instructionText: Put the tomato paste, salt, malt vinegar, garlic powder and onion powder in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Bring to the boil and cook for 15 minutes.
Cool, then store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, or freeze for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Taco Casserole
recipes.description: Baked Tex-Mex casserole of spiced taco beef, torn tortillas and plenty of melted cheese.

steps.instructionText: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium heat, then drain it and return it to the skillet.
Over medium heat, stir in the taco seasoning, chili powder, garlic powder and tomato sauce.
Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring now and then.
In a casserole dish, mix the beef mixture, tortilla bits and shredded cheese.
Bake at 190 °C (375 °F) for 20 minutes.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Latkes (Potato Pancakes)
recipes.description: Crisp pan-fried pancakes of grated potato and onion, served with applesauce or sour cream.

ingredients.name: applesauce or sour cream, to serve

steps.instructionText: Grate the potatoes and onion.
Squeeze the grated potato and onion well in cheesecloth or a fine sieve to drain off the moisture, so they fry properly.
Mix the drained potato and onion with the egg, matzo meal and salt.
Heat the vegetable oil in a 25 cm pan over medium heat until quite hot.
Drop 1-2 tablespoons of the mixture per pancake into the pan, flipping partway through so both sides fry.
Serve with applesauce or sour cream.

recipes.title: Spoonbread
recipes.description: Soft, souffle-like Southern cornmeal bake with scallions, red pepper and a little cheese.

steps.instructionText: Preheat the oven to 205 °C (400 °F). Thickly grease a 20 x 20 cm baking pan.
Beat the egg whites until stiff and set aside.
Heat the milk in a medium saucepan over medium heat until barely bubbling at the edges.
Reduce the heat and slowly whisk in the cornmeal. Keep whisking over low heat for 5 minutes.
Take off the heat and stir in the black pepper, red pepper flakes, salt and scallions.
Stir in the egg yolks and cheese, then fold in the whipped egg whites.
Pour into the pan and bake for about 30 minutes, until a toothpick in the centre comes out clean.

recipes.title: Sweet Cornbread
recipes.description: Tender cornbread sweetened with maple syrup and brown sugar, also known as Johnny Cake.

steps.instructionText: Beat the eggs lightly in a large bowl, then mix in the softened butter until loose.
Add the brown sugar and maple syrup and mix well, then stir in the salt.
Mix the cornmeal and baking powder, then blend them into the wet mixture.
Slowly add the all-purpose flour until you have a soft cake batter that sticks to the spoon and comes off in blobs. You may not need all of it.
Pour into a greased pan and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 15-25 minutes.

recipes.title: Corn Muffins
recipes.description: Moist, lightly sweet muffins of cornmeal and yogurt with a slightly crunchy golden crust.

steps.instructionText: Mix the cornmeal, all-purpose flour, sugar, baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and salt in a large bowl.
Whisk the eggs and yogurt together, then stir them quickly into the dry ingredients, leaving some lumps.
Fold in the melted butter.
Pour into ramekins or a muffin tin and bake at 200 °C (400 °F) for 15-18 minutes, until the tops are golden.

recipes.title: Seafood Gumbo
recipes.description: Louisiana stew built on a dark roux, with Andouille sausage, shrimp and oysters in a spicy seafood stock.

steps.instructionText: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot, then gradually whisk in the plain flour.
Cook the roux over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring constantly, until very dark reddish brown. Do not let it burn.
Stir in the onion, celery, bell pepper, garlic and okra. Cook for 10-15 minutes.
Slowly whisk in the shrimp stock.
Add the clam juice, oregano, thyme, bay leaves, salt, cayenne pepper, black pepper and parsley. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the Andouille sausage and simmer for another 30-40 minutes.
Add the shrimp and oysters and simmer just until cooked through.
Top with the green onions and serve, ideally over rice.

recipes.title: Dutch Oven Beans
recipes.description: Smoky, sweet pot of baked-style beans cooked with bacon, ground beef, molasses and ketchup.

steps.instructionText: Cut the bacon into bite-sized pieces and start cooking it in a heated Dutch oven (heavy pot).
Chop the onion into 1 cm pieces.
When the bacon is nearly cooked, crumble in the ground beef and onion. Cook until the onion is translucent.
Add all the beans, ketchup, brown sugar, dry mustard, molasses and Worcestershire sauce, and stir.
Bring to a simmer and let it bubble lightly for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in the liquid smoke, taste, and adjust with more ketchup, brown sugar, mustard or molasses.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Bake
recipes.description: Layers of spaghetti, creamy cheese mixture and meat sauce, baked with a Parmesan crumb top.

steps.instructionText: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Saute the ground meat with the onion. When cooked through, mix in the spaghetti sauce and Italian seasoning.
Combine the cream cheese, cottage cheese and sour cream and mix well.
Cook the spaghetti following the packet directions.
Grease a 3-litre baking dish. Layer half the spaghetti in the bottom and spoon the cheese mixture on top.
Add the rest of the spaghetti, then spread the meat mixture over it.
Mix the breadcrumbs and Parmesan cheese and sprinkle on top.
Bake for 30 minutes, until bubbly and heated through.

recipes.title: Cornbread and Chicken Casserole
recipes.description: Layered bake of shredded chicken and crumbled cornbread with Monterey Jack and a buttery crumb top.

steps.instructionText: Melt the 2 tbsp unsalted butter with the olive oil in a large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook until translucent.
Add the garlic and saute until golden. Remove from the pan and let cool.
Combine the chicken with the onion mixture, salt, black pepper and 1 cup of the Monterey Jack cheese.
Line a deep roasting pan with parchment. Put in just enough cornbread to coat the bottom, add a layer of the chicken mixture, and repeat until all is used.
Mix the remaining cheese, dried breadcrumbs and melted butter and sprinkle over the top layer.
Cover with foil and bake in the centre of a 190 °C (375 °F) oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the foil and bake for 15 more minutes, until browned and bubbly on top. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Potato Meat Loaf
recipes.description: Midwestern bake of sliced potato and onion under a spiced beef and sausage loaf with cheese soup.

steps.instructionText: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Put the sliced potatoes in a baking dish and lay the sliced onion over them.
Mix the ground beef, sausage, egg, soda crackers, chili powder, salt and pepper well.
Press the meat mixture over the onion, leaving a dip in the middle.
Pour the cheddar cheese soup into the dip.
Bake for 1 hour at 180 °C (350 °F).
Let it stand for 5 minutes before serving.
